artifacts.summary: Research on the Comparator doctor mode (binary presence + C3 version-match check) and the trust-model document, including a live-tested finding that binary introspection cannot detect the Lean toolchain a binary was built against and a directory walk-up alternative that can.

memory_candidates.content: When a doctor/health-check needs to verify which Lean toolchain a compiled Lean CLI binary (e.g. lean4export) was built against, do not rely on --version/--help (upstream tools like lean4export have none) or on `ldd`/dynamic-link introspection (nix-packaged Lean binaries statically link the runtime and carry no elan-toolchain path — confirmed empirically against a real nix-store `comparator` binary). Instead, `readlink -f` the resolved binary and walk up a bounded number of parent directories looking for a sibling `lean-toolchain` file (the artifact of the realistic `git clone` + `lake build` install route for a niche, non-nixpkgs-packaged tool), and diff its content against the target project's own `lean-toolchain`. Report an explicit 'unknown/cannot verify' state when no such file is found — never treat that as a pass.
